minor.issue: in_duel() uses _active(), which matches any duel with players.left != True and end > now-300s. It does not check the water/pond or that the duel is live. (1) A player who leaves the Duel Pier mid-duel (for example, a reload resets fr_mode to harbour) and fishes elsewhere has every catch swallowed: no fish, xp or gold. Those catches are still added to the duel score from another water. (2) For up to 5 min after the duel ends, if the player hasn't pressed 'Back to the harbour', any catch is swallowed: record_catch does nothing because end has passed, yet the land still returns duel:true. Suggested fix: make in_duel require start <= now < end AND the encounter water to be the duel water (store a duel flag on the encounter at cast time).

Calling leave during the live phase returns ok:true but does nothing (left is only set after end), so the player stays 'in duel' for scoring and land handling. Together with the issue above, this traps normal catches.
An old duel_live.record_catch call is left in the normal land path. It is harmless now because the in_duel branch returns earlier, but it is dead or confusing code.

issues: The popup shows the score in the user's weight unit ('+0.503 lb'), while the DuelHud scoreboard and result screen always show kg ('0.23 kg'). The units are inconsistent; the request expected '+X kg'. Use one unit (wt() everywhere or kg everywhere).

action_items: Limit duel_live.in_duel to live duels on the duel water. Otherwise catches made off the Duel Pier, or within 5 min after a duel ends, are silently thrown away.
Optional: show the duel catch score and the DuelHud in the same unit.
Optional: remove the unreachable record_catch call in the normal /fish/land path.
critical_code_review_comments: duel_live._active window (end > now-300s) is reused for in_duel, which mixes up 'showing the result screen' with 'currently competing'.
